ambiguity.detail: Catherine is shocked to learn Alexander married someone else.

verdict.hook_line: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A vengeful lord exposes a poisoning plot and marries his true love, only for the church to interrupt and invalidate the wedding.
verdict.why_it_works: High-stakes emotional confrontation with an immediate public wedding twist and a shocking religious intervention at the end.
